purpose: Freeze scenario texts, requirement definitions, method configurations, prompt/code versions and model identities before the single, prospective TEST execution. Produced by the package's own `prw freeze` command (prw_freeze_record.json, embedded verbatim below) plus supplementary readable fields not captured by that command.

repository.note: 20 files show as modified in `git status` at freeze time, none touched by this session's DEV/TEST pipeline work (they belong to earlier, unrelated thesis material -- PAPER.md/PAPER.pdf, chunk_api.py, evaluation/benchmark_v3/* annotation files). The commit hash alone does not fully pin those files' exact content; the workbench package's own integrity (prw/*.py, configs, DEV/TEST scenario and requirement files) is separately and exactly guaranteed by the sha256 hashes below, independent of the outer repository's clean/dirty state.

retrieval_configuration.interpretation: Total final budget is 10 chunks, not 10 per lane (5/5 quota with backfill). Character cap is not a token count. Same config used for all four systems and both DEV and TEST -- matched budgets.

controller_configuration.note: controller.py's hash here is identical to the pre-DEV-run checkpoint recorded in research_state/controller_freeze_2026-09-07.json -- confirms zero controller/prompt drift across the entire DEV-scale run.

model_configuration.resolution: Model identity is resolved at runtime from environment variables (PRW_CONTROLLER_MODEL, PRW_JUDGE_A/B/C_MODEL, PRW_ADJUDICATOR_MODEL, PRW_GENERATOR_MODEL), not hardcoded in the config file.
model_configuration.repeated_model_disclosure: All controller/judge/adjudicator/generator slots point at the same single model. This is a repeated-model configuration, not genuine model diversity -- disclosed throughout every prior report in this project, restated here.

relevance_rubric_version.bundle_judge_contract: v2 -- positional judgments array, harness-assigned requirement_id, no quoted spans, one bounded repair attempt (prw/bundles.py, hash above)
relevance_rubric_version.pointwise_judge_contract: v2 -- same pattern applied to prw/judging.py (hash above), fixed during this same finalization pass after it crashed on the first DEV pooled-judging attempt
relevance_rubric_version.bundle_sufficiency_status: EXPLORATORY (demoted from primary after observed substantive false-positive judgments -- see docs/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md status update and results/pilot3_v2/PILOT_REPORT_V2.md sec 6)

random_seeds.note: Retrieval and judging themselves are not seeded (LLM sampling is provider-controlled, not seeded by this harness); the only seeded randomness in this pipeline is the bootstrap resampling used for paired confidence intervals (prw/metrics.py::paired_bootstrap and evaluation/final_retrieval_benchmark/build_final_tables.py::paired_bootstrap), which is why paired CIs are exactly reproducible from saved per-scenario metrics even though individual LLM judgments are not bit-reproducible from a fresh API call.

test_inspection_disclosure.detail: This session authored the 20 TEST scenarios, their requirements, and their corpus-verified gold evidence earlier in this project (evaluation/final_retrieval_benchmark construction). It has read the full text and gold of every TEST scenario. It therefore CANNOT serve as the independent 'separate evaluator process' that a genuine held-out test freeze calls for -- this exact limitation was recorded in research_state/LAST_CHECKPOINT.md multiple times prior to this freeze, not discovered only now.
test_inspection_disclosure.detail_2: No TEST-split run, judgment, or metric has been executed or viewed by this session at any point before this freeze record was created. Scenario/gold TEXT was read during construction; TEST OUTCOMES have not been. No decision about the controller, prompts, retrieval configuration, or judge contracts has been made using any TEST outcome.
test_inspection_disclosure.recommendation: State this plainly in the thesis reproducibility notes, exactly as phrased here. If the department/examiner requires a genuinely independent TEST execution, a different session or a human, blind to the TEST construction process, should re-run Phase 4 from this freeze record.
